checkpoint: nov03-w5 shard 12: NONMATCHING draft rewritten without asm barriers; spill-slot order of the nine loop-hoisted addresses now matches.

areas.label: Control flow reconstruction
areas.evidence: HUD loop: three bar redraws (HP 0xC4/0x62 to 0x06008060, MP 0xC2/0x60 to 0x06008160, third gauge 0xC6 vs stats+0xA0+s8 0x79 to 0x06008260), palette 0xFF fade, level sprite branch (states 3-4 and 6-7), BG tile blink and four sub_0805FB7C number draws. Draft CFG reproduces all calls, literal pools and branch layout, including the far 'return i' block of the inlined level lookup (same code as sub_08015E84).

areas.label: Complete compilable draft
areas.evidence: make compare OK (ASM fallback) and make nonmatching OK. Candidate 2478 bytes vs original 2486.

areas.label: Frame, spill slots and registers
areas.evidence: Frame and every stack slot match, including the nine hoisted invariants at 0xD8-0xF8. Key finding: their slot order follows GCSE PRE reaching-reg creation, i.e. expression hash-table bucket order (hash % N, N = max_cuid/2+1). The original needs N=579 (or 605); the draft now reaches N=579 naturally (dropped the redundant third f26 clamp; check with agbcc -dG, 'Expression hash table (579 buckets'). The 'changed' flag is the same variable as loop index i (gives r5 like the original), the level result/clamp use i and j, mx3 is computed as max = stats[0x28]; max += f79. Inline level helper is plain C (no asm). Remaining: bar n/bound register swap (r3/r2), bar-3 stats+0xA0 register, ldrb+lsl/asr of f6C (draft gives ldrsb), cross-jumped f26 clamp tails in the state 3-4 branch. Normalized diff ~266 lines (was ~1180).
